articles.title: 谷歌AI模式可订机票酒店
articles.summary: 谷歌的AI Mode新增追踪航班价格、预订酒店等功能，正从信息搜索转向旅行代理。
articles.why: AI开始帮你完成实际任务，不只是查信息，旅行规划将更省心。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 试试用AI Mode规划一次旅行，感受AI代理的便利。
articles.for_me: 以后旅行可以用AI订票订酒店，省时省力，值得关注。

articles.title: 谷歌笔记应用可交互书籍
articles.summary: 谷歌Gemini Notebook新增功能，可导入Google Play Books的书籍，提问并生成笔记、播客等。
articles.why: 学习工具升级，AI能帮你从书中提取知识，生成学习材料。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 用Gemini Notebook导入一本英文原著，提问并生成摘要，辅助英语学习。
articles.for_me: 对英语专业学习超有用！可以导入英文书，让AI帮你总结、提问，提高阅读效率。

articles.title: AI公司联手防御恶意AI
articles.summary: OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌等100多家公司联合呼吁加强网络安全，抵御恶意AI攻击。
articles.why: AI安全成行业共识，未来可能有更多防护措施，保护用户数据。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注AI安全新闻，了解如何保护自己免受AI相关风险。
articles.for_me: 虽然暂时用不上，但了解AI安全趋势对备考AI研究生有帮助。

articles.title: 法院裁定Anthropic黑名单违宪
articles.summary: 法院裁定五角大楼将Anthropic列入黑名单违宪，Anthropic在与特朗普政府的斗争中获胜。
articles.why: AI公司与政府博弈，影响行业监管走向，可能改变AI发展环境。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 留意AI公司与政府的关系，理解政策对AI发展的影响。
articles.for_me: 对备考AI研究生，了解政策案例有助于理解AI伦理与法律。

articles.title: Hugging Face推出溜冰鸭机器人
articles.summary: Hugging Face的Pollen Robotics推出可爱机器人Microduck，高约25厘米，售价399美元，可预购。
articles.why: AI机器人走向消费市场，可爱设计降低门槛，可能成为新玩具。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注消费级机器人，体验AI在实体世界的应用。
articles.for_me: 暂时不用管，但可以当趣闻了解，未来可能用于教育或娱乐。

articles.title: Plaud推出AI耳机记录对话
articles.summary: Plaud发布AI耳机，可录音、转写、总结对话，支持4G上传，类似智能录音笔。
articles.why: AI可穿戴设备普及，会议记录、学习笔记更便捷。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 考虑用AI耳机辅助课堂录音和笔记，提高学习效率。
articles.for_me: 对英语专业学习有用，可录下课堂或对话，AI总结要点，方便复习。

articles.title: 英伟达CEO称已实现AGI
articles.summary: 黄仁勋在财报电话会上称英伟达已“实现AGI”，但随即表示这没有意义，引发讨论。
articles.why: AGI概念被滥用，但反映AI进展迅速，普通人需理性看待。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 别被AGI噱头迷惑，关注实际应用更实在。
articles.for_me: 备考AI研究生时，理解AGI争议有助于形成批判性思维。

articles.title: AI人才流向谷歌
articles.summary: Thinking Machines联合创始人Barret Zoph离开OpenAI后加入谷歌，AI人才争夺激烈。
articles.why: 顶尖人才流向影响AI发展格局，谷歌或加速技术突破。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注AI公司人才动态，了解技术方向。
articles.for_me: 暂时不用管，但可留意谷歌后续产品更新。

articles.title: AI致安卓内存限制收紧
articles.summary: 谷歌因AI数据中心导致硬件短缺，为安卓应用设置新内存限制，低端手机或受影响。
articles.why: AI发展影响硬件资源，普通用户手机性能可能受影响。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 留意手机更新，若内存不足可清理应用。
articles.for_me: 暂时不用管，但若用安卓手机，关注系统更新提示。

articles.title: 智谱开源多模态模型
articles.summary: 智谱AI开源GLM-5.3-Flash原生多模态模型，支持图像、文本等处理。
articles.why: 开源模型降低使用门槛，开发者可免费使用，推动AI普及。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注开源模型，可免费体验最新AI能力。
articles.for_me: 对学习AI工具有帮助，可尝试用该模型处理图像和文本，提升英语学习素材处理。

plain_summary: 今天AI圈热闹非凡：谷歌把AI模式升级成旅行代理，能帮你订机票酒店；Gemini Notebook还能导入书籍，学习更高效。AI安全成为焦点，100多家公司联手防御恶意AI，法院也裁定Anthropic黑名单违宪。Hugging Face推出可爱机器人，Plaud发布AI耳机，消费级AI产品越来越多。英伟达CEO又提AGI，但自己都说没意义，别被噱头带偏。智谱开源新模型，免费可用。总之，AI正从聊天走向实际任务，工具越来越实用，但也要理性看待炒作。

top_starred.name: affaan-m/ECC
top_starred.desc: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
top_starred.tagline: AI代理性能优化系统，提升智能体效率与安全
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个针对AI代理（比如Claude Code、Codex等编程助手）的性能优化工具。它解决的是AI代理在运行过程中可能出现的效率低下、记忆不准确、安全漏洞等问题。通过提供技能、本能、记忆、安全等功能，让AI代理更聪明、更可靠。普通人可能不太直接使用它，但如果你是开发者，使用Claude Code等工具时，它可以让你定制的AI代理更听话、更高效。比如，你可以给它添加特定的技能，让它自动处理重复性任务，或者加强它的安全设置，防止它执行危险操作。适合有一定编程基础、想深度定制AI代理的开发者，上手需要一些学习成本，但官方文档和社区支持会帮助你。

top_starred.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
top_starred.desc: The agent that grows with you
top_starred.tagline: 能随你成长的AI代理框架
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个AI代理框架，它的特点是‘与你一起成长’。它解决的是AI代理无法适应个人需求变化的问题。普通用户可以用它来创建自己的AI助手，这个助手会随着你的使用习惯和反馈不断改进。比如，你可以教它你的工作流程，它会逐渐学会自动处理邮件、安排日程等。它适合那些希望有一个个性化AI助手、但不想从零编程的人。上手难度中等，需要一些Python基础，但项目提供了友好的接口和示例，让你可以逐步定制。

top_starred.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
top_starred.desc: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
top_starred.tagline: 让每个人都能用的自主AI工具
top_starred.explanation: AutoGPT是一个开源项目，目标是让AI对所有人可用。它解决的是普通人难以利用大型语言模型（如GPT）来自动完成复杂任务的问题。通过AutoGPT，你可以设定一个目标，比如‘帮我研究市场趋势并生成报告’，它会自动分解任务、调用工具、收集信息，最后给出结果。它适合那些想用AI自动化工作流程但不会编程的人。上手相对简单，有图形界面，但需要一些配置。对于创作者，可以用它来自动生成内容、分析数据等。

top_starred.name: ollama/ollama
top_starred.desc: Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
top_starred.tagline: 本地运行多种AI模型的工具
top_starred.explanation: Ollama是一个让你在本地电脑上轻松运行各种AI模型的工具，比如DeepSeek、Qwen等。它解决的是在线AI服务可能存在的隐私泄露、网络延迟和费用问题。普通用户可以用它来在本地运行聊天机器人、写作助手等，无需联网，数据更安全。比如，你可以下载一个模型，然后像使用ChatGPT一样在本地对话，但完全免费且离线。它适合注重隐私的普通用户和开发者，上手非常简单，只需安装并运行几条命令即可。

top_starred.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
top_starred.desc: The context API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. 🔥
top_starred.tagline: 大规模网页搜索与抓取API
top_starred.explanation: Firecrawl是一个API服务，用于搜索、抓取和与网页交互，可以大规模处理。它解决的是开发者需要从大量网页中提取数据但手动抓取麻烦且易被屏蔽的问题。普通用户可能不直接使用，但很多AI应用（比如自动摘要、市场分析）会依赖它。比如，你可以用它来抓取新闻网站的所有文章，然后让AI分析趋势。它适合开发者，上手需要一些编程知识，但API文档清晰，有免费额度。

trending.name: Tiger3807861189/DeepSeek-V4-J-Space-Capability-Realization-Report
trending.desc: DeepSeek V4 × J-Space capability realization report — benchmark evidence that J-Space reduces capability-realization loss on DeepSeek V4.
trending.explanation: 这个项目是一个关于DeepSeek V4模型在J-Space环境下能力实现情况的报告，提供了基准测试证据。它解决的是AI模型在实际部署中可能出现的性能损失问题。对于普通用户，这个报告可能过于技术化，但如果你是企业决策者或AI工程师，它可以帮你了解在特定环境下模型的表现，从而优化部署。它适合技术人员，需要理解基准测试和模型评估概念，但报告本身是中文的，易于阅读。

trending.name: Zyrexnn/Cybermes
trending.desc: Autonomous Offensive Security, Bug Bounty & Red Teaming Agent Framework powered by Hermes Agent, specialized reasoning skills, and multi-model LLM orchestration.
trending.tagline: 自主安全测试AI代理框架
trending.explanation: Cybermes是一个用于自动化安全测试、漏洞赏金和红队操作的AI代理框架。它解决的是网络安全领域需要大量人工测试但效率低下的问题。普通用户可能不直接使用，但安全研究人员可以用它来自动扫描漏洞、模拟攻击。比如，你可以让它自动对网站进行安全测试，并生成报告。它适合有安全背景的开发者，上手需要一定的安全知识和编程能力，但项目提供了详细的文档。

trending.name: fufankeji/deepseek-harness-studio
trending.desc: DeepSeek Harness 零代码桌面端｜一键启动，支持 Windows 与 macOS；内置插件发现、热点插件推送、一键安装与管理、AI 智能推荐和视觉增强。
trending.explanation: 这是一个桌面应用程序，让你无需编程就能使用DeepSeek Harness。它解决的是非技术用户难以使用复杂AI工具的问题。普通用户可以通过它一键启动DeepSeek模型，并管理插件。比如，你可以用它来运行一个本地聊天机器人，或者安装一些插件来增强功能。它适合完全不懂技术的用户，上手非常简单，只需下载安装即可，界面友好。

trending.name: rome-os/rome
trending.explanation: Rome是一个概念性的‘智能体操作系统’，旨在为AI代理提供一个完整的运行环境。它解决的是AI代理在传统操作系统上运行不顺畅的问题。普通用户可能暂时用不上，但开发者可以基于它构建更强大的AI应用。比如，你可以将Rome作为底层系统，让AI代理更好地管理文件、网络等资源。它适合有经验的开发者，上手难度较高，需要理解操作系统和AI代理的概念。

trending.name: only-cli/oc
trending.desc: Turn any website into a compact CLI tailored for AI agents. Browse the web in hundreds of tokens, not tens of thousands.
trending.tagline: 把网站变成AI代理的轻量命令行工具
trending.explanation: 这个工具可以将任何网站转换成一个简洁的命令行界面，专为AI代理设计。它解决的是AI代理浏览网页时消耗大量token（处理文本的单位）的问题。普通用户可能不直接使用，但开发者可以用它来让AI代理更高效地获取网页信息。比如，你可以用它来让AI代理快速获取新闻标题，而不用加载整个页面。它适合开发者，上手需要一些命令行知识，但使用简单。

spaces.name: kulkas2pintu/wan555
spaces.desc: generate a video from an image with a text prompt
spaces.tagline: 用一张图片和文字描述生成视频的AI工具
spaces.explanation: 这个应用能根据你提供的一张静态图片和一段文字描述，自动生成一段动态视频。比如，你有一张风景照，输入“太阳从山后升起，云彩飘动”，它就能生成一段太阳升起、云彩飘动的视频。对于普通人来说，你可以用它来制作简单的动态壁纸或社交媒体短视频，不需要任何视频编辑技能。对于学英语的人，你可以用英文描述场景，既练习了英语写作，又直观看到描述对应的画面。上手非常简单，只需上传图片、输入文字，点击生成即可，通常几分钟内就能看到结果。

spaces.name: Saravutw/Omni-videos-custom
spaces.desc: text to video, image to video, video extend
spaces.tagline: 全能视频生成器：文字、图片都能变视频，还能延长
spaces.explanation: 这个应用提供了多种视频生成功能：你可以直接输入文字描述生成视频（text-to-video），也可以上传一张图片让它动起来（image-to-video），甚至可以把一段已有的视频延长（video extend）。比如，你写一段“一只猫在沙发上打滚”，它就能生成对应的视频；或者你上传一张猫咪照片，它也能让猫咪动起来。对于学生，你可以用它来制作学习动画，比如将历史事件描述成视频，帮助记忆。操作界面友好，选择功能、上传素材、输入描述即可，无需编程知识，适合零基础用户。

spaces.name: mpasila/Krea-2-Turbo_I2I
spaces.desc: Krea 2 Turbo text2image and image editing
spaces.tagline: 用文字生成或编辑图片的AI绘画工具
spaces.explanation: 这个应用基于Krea 2 Turbo模型，可以让你通过文字描述生成全新的图片，或者对现有图片进行编辑修改。比如，你输入“一只戴着帽子的柴犬”，它就能生成一张这样的图片；如果你有一张自己的照片，输入“把背景换成海滩”，它也能帮你修改。对于学英语的人，你可以用英文描述你想要的图片，既练习了英语，又得到了视觉反馈。上手很简单，只需输入文字或上传图片，选择模式，点击生成即可。适合创意设计、社交媒体配图等场景。

spaces.name: pnemrow/Qwen-Image-Edit-Rapid-AIO-Loras-Experimental-neo
spaces.desc: Demo of the Collection of Qwen Image Edit LoRAs
spaces.tagline: 集合多种图像编辑模型的AI工具箱
spaces.explanation: 这个应用是一个演示，集合了多个Qwen图像编辑LoRA模型，可以让你对图片进行各种编辑操作，比如修改物体、改变风格、添加元素等。例如，你有一张人物照片，你可以用文字指令“给人物戴上墨镜”，它就能实现。对于学生，你可以用它来探索AI图像编辑的多种可能性，比如将普通照片变成动漫风格。操作上，选择不同的LoRA模型，上传图片并输入指令即可。界面可能稍显复杂，但每个模型都有说明，适合对AI图像编辑感兴趣的新手尝试。

spaces.name: pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator
spaces.tagline: 模拟机器人Microduck的在线沙盒环境
spaces.explanation: 这是一个基于Docker的在线模拟环境，用于测试和体验Microduck机器人（可能是一个虚拟机器人或无人机）的控制和算法。它提供了一个沙盒，让你可以在虚拟环境中编写代码来控制机器人，观察其行为。对于普通人来说，可能不太直接，但对于学习编程或机器人技术的学生，这是一个很好的实践平台。你可以通过简单的Python代码控制机器人的移动、避障等。上手需要一些编程基础，但环境已经配置好，你只需在网页上编写代码并运行，适合对AI和机器人感兴趣的学习者。

models.name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
models.tagline: 能看图和文字的多模态AI模型，快速响应
models.explanation: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next是一个多模态AI模型，可以同时理解图片和文字输入，并生成文字回复。比如，你上传一张猫的照片，问“这是什么动物？”，它能回答“这是一只猫”。对于普通人，你可以用它来识别图片内容、获取图片描述等。对于学英语的人，你可以上传图片并用英文提问，练习英语问答。这个模型是“Flash”版本，意味着响应速度快，适合实时交互。上手非常简单，只需在聊天界面输入文字或上传图片即可，无需任何技术知识。

models.name: zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash
models.tagline: 高效文本生成模型，擅长对话和写作
models.explanation: GLM-5.3-Flash是一个专注于文本生成的AI模型，可以用于对话、写作、翻译等任务。比如，你可以让它帮你写一篇短文、翻译一段英文，或者进行头脑风暴。对于学生，它是一个很好的学习助手，可以解释概念、提供写作建议。这个模型是“Flash”版本，速度快，适合实时聊天。上手非常简单，就像使用聊天机器人一样，输入问题或指令，它就会回复。无需任何技术背景，适合所有人群。

models.name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
models.tagline: 强大的多模态模型，能处理复杂图文任务
models.explanation: Qwen3.8-27B是一个大型多模态模型，参数规模达270亿，能处理更复杂的图像和文本理解任务。比如，你可以上传一张复杂的图表，让它总结数据趋势；或者让它根据图片写一段故事。对于备考AI方向的学生，这个模型展示了当前AI在视觉和语言结合上的能力。使用上，通常通过API或特定平台访问，可能需要一些技术知识，但许多在线演示也提供了简单的界面。上手难度中等，但一旦接入，功能强大。

models.name: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF
models.tagline: 压缩版Qwen3.8模型，可在普通电脑运行
models.explanation: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF是Qwen3.8-27B模型的量化版本，通过压缩技术减小了模型大小，使得它可以在普通电脑或手机上运行，而不需要高端服务器。比如，你可以下载这个模型，在本地运行一个聊天机器人，无需联网。对于学生，这提供了一个学习AI模型部署的机会，可以尝试在本地运行和微调。上手需要一些技术知识，比如安装软件和命令行操作，但网上有教程。适合对AI技术感兴趣、想动手实践的人。

models.name: unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF
models.tagline: 快速版Qwen3.8的压缩模型，适合本地使用
models.explanation: unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF是Qwen3.8-Flash-Next模型的量化版本，同样是为了在资源有限的设备上运行而优化。它保留了快速响应的特点，同时减小了体积。比如，你可以把它集成到自己的应用中，实现快速的图像问答功能。对于开发者或学生，这是一个很好的资源，可以学习如何部署AI模型。上手需要一些编程基础，但模型文件可以直接下载使用。适合想深入AI应用开发的人。

items.title_en: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
items.summary: Recent video generation models are increasingly framed as world models. Many physical processes can unfold in more than one valid way. Therefore, a world model should reproduce not only a plausible trajectory, but also the distribution of possible behaviors under the same initial observation and action. We call this distribution-level requirement probabilistic alignment. However, existing evaluations largely assess individual-video plausibility and do not test whether repeated generations recove
items.title_cn: PAWBench：我们离概率对齐的世界建模还有多远？
items.note: 研究视频生成模型能否生成符合物理规律的概率分布，对理解世界模型前沿有帮助。

items.title_en: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report
items.summary: AI-powered digital avatar streamers must answer product questions, engage viewers, and execute marketing strategies in real time, demanding low latency, frequent strategy updates, and accurate yet effective responses. Evolvable Harnesses, whose Skills, Hooks, prompts, and tools can be updated independently of model weights, enable rapid iteration but expose a trade-off: large models adapt zero-shot yet are too slow, whereas compact models meet latency targets but overfit to fixed Harness configu
items.title_cn: 训练智能体与其装备共同进化：TaoLive数字虚拟人技术报告
items.note: 介绍数字人直播系统如何平衡速度与策略更新，对AI应用落地感兴趣可看。

items.title_en: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
items.summary: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts th
items.title_cn: TTPO：测试时策略优化
items.note: 提出无需真实标签的推理优化方法，对理解强化学习新进展有价值。

items.title_en: What Makes Good Agentic Data? An ACE Lens on Data Generation for LLM Agents
items.summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on generated interaction data to learn how to interact with external environments. Agentic data generation must maintain consistency among environments, tasks, interactions, and success signals while producing experience that is useful rather than merely abundant. Existing work spans many agent domains, but domain-centered organization and heterogeneous evaluation often obscure common generation mechanisms and conflate candidate construction with verification and sel
items.title_cn: 什么造就好的智能体数据？ACE视角下的LLM智能体数据生成
items.note: 探讨如何生成高质量智能体训练数据，对数据工程和智能体研究有启发。

items.title_en: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City
items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can interpret a street view, but urban agency depends on whether such local evidence remains useful after the agent starts to move. In this paper, we investigate how far current MLLM agents can turn local urban perception into reliable action in a complicated real-scale city. We propose UrbanGround, the first sandbox to make this question testable in a physically constrained replica of Hong Kong built from territory-wide 3D geospatial data. UrbanGround su
items.title_cn: UrbanGround：从局部感知到真实规模城市中的空间代理
items.note: 测试多模态模型在城市环境中的导航能力，对具身智能感兴趣可看。

items.title_en: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction
items.summary: Conversational systems, such as duplex speech language models (SLMs), still lack a streaming, accurate, and empathetic memory system as their soul. We introduce VoiceMem, a simple memory architecture with a parallel informational left brain, an emotional right brain, and streaming memory I/O mechanisms. We further build a complete pipeline for memory-aware SLM training, long-horizon evaluation, and decoupled deployment with interchangeable memory backends. Experiments and real-world deployment s
items.title_cn: VoiceMem：用于实时交互的流式双脑记忆
items.note: 提出带情感记忆的语音对话系统架构，对语音AI和记忆机制有兴趣可看。

items.title_en: VGI-Bench: Probing Visual Intelligence in Video Generation Models
items.summary: Recent studies suggest that video generation models can exhibit certain forms of zero-shot visual reasoning through generated frames. Yet reliable evaluation remains challenging: benchmarks should adopt inputs aligned with the visual priors of current video models, require valid evolving processes rather than only plausible final states, and calibrate task difficulty to remain challenging yet partly feasible. To this end, we introduce VGI-bench, containing 27 tasks and 810 instances, organized b
items.title_cn: VGI-Bench：探测视频生成模型中的视觉智能
items.note: 设计基准测试视频生成模型的视觉推理能力，对评估方法有参考价值。

items.title_en: FrontierChallenge: Evaluating Scientific Workflow Completion
items.summary: Scientific agents increasingly analyze data, execute code, and produce research artifacts, yet most benchmarks emphasize final answers, isolated programs, or a single domain. We introduce FrontierChallenge, a cross-domain benchmark comprising 300 end-to-end scientific workflows. In this paper, we release and evaluate 97 of these tasks, spanning quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, materials characterization, analytical chemistry, life science, and electrochemistry/environment. Each task provid
items.title_cn: FrontierChallenge：评估科学工作流完成度
items.note: 跨领域科学工作流基准，对AI for Science方向有参考价值。

items.title_en: WarpSAC: Towards the Pinnacle of Scalable Off-policy RL by Rethinking Exploration and Exploitation
items.summary: Massively parallel simulation changes the data regime in which off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is trained, challenging stabilizers designed for data-limited replay. Through controlled experiments across eight benchmark families, we show that these stabilizers are data-regime-dependent: parameter normalization helps with narrow replay coverage but restricts value fitting when data are abundant, while clipped double-Q can be relaxed in high-throughput manipulation. Age-biased replay weighti
items.title_cn: WarpSAC：通过重新思考探索与利用实现可扩展的离策略强化学习
items.note: 研究大规模并行模拟下强化学习的稳定性，对RL实践有指导意义。

items.title_en: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning
items.summary: Native visual reasoning treats visual generation as the medium of reasoning itself: visual states (i.e. images and videos) are not merely inputs to be understood or outputs to be rendered, but first-class substrates for problem solving beyond language. Yet progress remains bottlenecked by the lack of scalable training tasks, reliable feedback, and controlled comparisons across generative substrates. In this work, we introduce VBVR-Pro, a closed-loop testbed that makes native visual reasoning thr
items.title_cn: VBVR-Pro：可扩展且可验证的原生视觉推理套件
items.note: 推动视觉生成作为推理媒介的研究，对多模态推理感兴趣可看。

items.title_en: Annotations as Rollouts: Efficient and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Video MLLMs
items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become a prevailing paradigm for unified video perception. However, post-training on large multi-task datasets remains challenging, as existing reinforcement learning methods sample on-policy groups with few high-quality rollouts even with costly chain-of-thought (CoT) generation. items.title_cn: 注释作为轨迹：视频多模态大模型的高效可扩展强化学习
items.note: 利用注释提升视频MLLM的RL训练效率，对多模态训练有启发。

items.title_en: GigaBrain-0.7: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Emergent Capabilities with a Three-System Architecture
items.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become a dominant paradigm for generalist embodied agents, demonstrating strong complex and long-horizon task completion in structured settings. Yet it remains an open question whether current VLA systems can benefit from more effective architectural design, scale to substantially larger and more heterogeneous data regimes, and achieve broader generalization across tasks and embodiments. items.title_cn: GigaBrain-0.7：通过三系统架构扩展具身基础模型至涌现能力

items.title_en: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
items.summary: Universal multimodal embeddings are becoming a core component of modern AI systems, enabling heterogeneous content to be represented in a shared space for applications such as retrieval, recommendation, classification, and agentic systems. In this report, we present WeMM-Embedding, a family of universal multimodal embedding models supporting text, images, videos, visual documents, and arbitrarily interleaved multimodal inputs with flexible output dimensions. items.title_cn: WeMM-Embedding：微信多模态嵌入技术报告

items.title_en: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
items.summary: LLM agents remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, where small local failures can compound over extended interactions and lead to overall task failure. Although external harnesses can substantially improve robustness, harness design remains a manual and expensive process that requires searching over a large space of prompts, tool configurations, and control logic. items.title_cn: AutoSaddler：从智能体执行轨迹自动优化装备

items.title_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation in Diffusion Models
items.summary: Reinforcement learning can align diffusion models with human preferences and task-specific objectives, but endpoint rewards do not specify how an intermediate denoising prediction should change. We introduce DiffusionOPSD as an on-policy self-distillation framework that converts image-level reward guidance into explicit targets for clean-output predictions at sampled queries. items.title_cn: 扩散模型中的在线自蒸馏

items.title_en: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work
items.summary: General-purpose language models can reason and synthesize knowledge, but complex work also requires sustained interaction with files, information sources, and executable code, together with state maintenance, failure recovery, and verifiable delivery. We call this working capability: sustained, verifiable progress toward a real-world objective. Apodex 1.1 develops this capability along two complementary dimensions. items.title_cn: Apodex 1.1：扩展复杂工作的智能体能力
items.note: 提升智能体在复杂任务中的持续工作能力，对智能体工程有参考。

items.title_en: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models
items.summary: We present EchoWM, an omnimodal world model for enterable generative media that responds to continuous navigation while jointly generating 720p video, environmental sound, music and speech. We organize interaction around camera intent: in first-person scenes, it specifies observer motion, while in third-person scenes, camera--character dynamics are learned from data without view-specific controllers. items.title_cn: EchoWM：开放可进入的全模态世界模型

items.title_en: TLive-Omni: An Omni-Modal Understanding Model for E-Commerce Live Streaming
items.summary: E-commerce live streaming requires omni-modal understanding of noisy, temporally extended streams, where product facts are distributed across speech, video frames, product images, overlaid text, and user queries. We present TLive-Omni, an omni-modal understanding model tailored to live-commerce scenarios. It maps image, video, audio, and text inputs into a unified representation space. items.title_cn: TLive-Omni：电商直播的全模态理解模型
items.note: 针对电商直播场景的多模态理解，对应用落地有参考价值。

items.title_en: Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision
items.summary: Existing image editing frameworks predominantly follow the training paradigm of text-to-image diffusion models. However, extending this paradigm to image editing highlights two inherent discrepancies, specifically, the insufficient attention to edit concept granularity and the training inefficiency caused by sparse supervision signals. items.title_cn: 通过概念缩放和密集监督释放图像编辑潜力
items.note: 构建大规模图像编辑数据集，对图像编辑研究有参考价值。

items.title_en: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
items.summary: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. items.title_cn: Prime Agent：一个自我改进的RLM装备
items.note: 开源的长时程智能体装备，对智能体开发有参考价值。

items.title_en: Graph Engineering in the Era of LLM Agents: From Individual Intelligence to System Intelligence
items.summary: LLMs have evolved from language generators to autonomous agents capable of complex, long-horizon tasks. This evolution has produced paradigms including Prompt Engineering to elicit model capabilities, Context Engineering to manage information access, Harness Engineering to organize external tools and resources, and Loop Engineering to support continual reflection and self-improvement. items.title_cn: LLM智能体时代的图工程：从个体智能到系统智能
items.note: 探讨图结构在智能体系统中的应用，对系统智能设计有启发。

items.title_en: Let's Scale Step by Step: Compute-Efficient Hyperparameter Transfer for Large-Scale Mixture-of-Experts
items.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures significantly expand model capacity without a proportional increase in computational cost. However, optimizing their hyperparameters---particularly the learning rate---at extreme scales of both model size and token budget via sweeping remains computationally prohibitive. items.title_cn: 让我们逐步扩展：大规模混合专家模型的计算高效超参数迁移
items.note: 提出MoE超参数迁移方法，对大规模模型训练有参考价值。

items.title_en: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence
items.summary: Parallel reasoning improves the accuracy and robustness of large reasoning models by exploring multiple solution paths, but its computational cost grows with reasoning depth and branch count. Existing methods for managing these parallel paths typically rely on final-answer consensus, local token confidence, or isolated intermediate probes. items.title_cn: ParaTempo：通过时间置信度实现高效并行推理
items.note: 优化并行推理的计算效率，对推理加速有参考价值。

items.title_en: InfinityEdit: Infinite Video Editing with a Lightweight Edit-Ignition Adapter
items.summary: With large pretrained models, existing methods have effectively improved instruction-based video editing. However, most of them rely on an in-place editing assumption. They align the edited video with the given source clip frame by frame over a fixed time span. This pattern fails for open-ended streams, e.g., restyling a live game or applying a camera move to an ongoing shot. items.title_cn: InfinityEdit：轻量级编辑点火适配器的无限视频编辑
items.note: 支持流式视频编辑，对视频编辑应用有参考价值。

items.title_en: Beyond Correctness: Benchmarking and Aligning Response Behaviors in Hybrid-Thinking MLLMs
items.summary: Hybrid-thinking multimodal large language models (MLLMs) allow a single model to alternate between deliberative thinking and latency-efficient non-thinking inference. Although these modes differ in reasoning budget, their delivered responses should satisfy the same user-facing standard. items.title_cn: 超越正确性：混合思维多模态大模型的响应行为基准与对齐
items.note: 评估混合推理模式下的响应质量，对多模态对齐有参考价值。

items.title_en: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
items.summary: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet these environments are hand-built and static: blind to an agent's weaknesses, and quickly left behind as it improves. While recent environment generation methods attempt to address this, they require domain-specific pipelines, rely on expensive or unreliable verifiers, and still produce static environments. items.title_cn: EnvHarness：唤醒静态世界以促进智能体学习

items.title_en: FACET: Preserving Source Intent and Executable State in Terminal Task Synthesis
items.summary: Training terminal agents requires scalable executable supervision, yet synthesizing high-quality terminal tasks remains challenging. Each task couples an instruction, an initialized environment, a reference solution, and an executable verifier; if these artifacts are generated from inconsistent assumptions, the resulting task may be unsolvable or incorrectly evaluated. items.title_cn: FACET：在终端任务合成中保留源意图和可执行状态
items.note: 合成高质量终端任务，对智能体训练数据生成有参考价值。

items.title_en: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
items.summary: We present 4DAnyone, a framework for reconstructing 4D humans from an uncalibrated monocular video by generating reconstruction-grade multiview-consistent videos and lifting them into 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS). items.title_en: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
items.summary: Software increasingly functions as part of the scientific instrument itself, making failures in scientific code capable of compromising not only program behavior but also the evidence underlying scientific conclusions. Yet existing evaluations of coding agents largely emphasize aggregate task success, providing limited insight into why agents fail when repairing scientific software. items.title_en: WithEveryone: Unified Planning and Identity Grounding for Group Image Generation
items.summary: Identity-preserving image generation becomes increasingly unreliable when a scene must contain many specified people. Beyond retaining each identity, the model must bind every reference to a distinct person and location, while training-time identity losses must establish correspondence among several noisy predicted faces. items.title_cn: WithEveryone：群像生成的统一规划与身份绑定

items.title_en: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation
items.summary: We introduce Semantic Task Completion Video Generation, an outcome-oriented video generation task. Under this formulation, success requires both achievement of the intended outcome and semantic grounding. Semantic grounding characterizes the correspondence between the reference image and the generated outcome in terms of high-level semantics relevant to the task. items.title_en: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
items.summary: Embodied agents are increasingly used to close the gap left by end-to-end policy models. Yet the agentic path has not realized closed-loop learning in physical execution: existing harnesses remain largely open-loop, following fixed skills during rollout and reflecting only after an episode completes. items.title_en: SemaPLC: A Project-Grounded, Verification-Gated Agent Harness for PLC Code Generation
items.summary: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) run industrial plants, and large language models can already generate independent program organization units (POUs) for them. Whether such logic integrates into an existing PLC project and then runs correctly has been checked only in limited tests. items.note: 提升PLC代码生成的可靠性，对工业自动化有参考价值。

items.title_en: Co-RL: Unsupervised Reasoning Emerges from Diverse Cohort in Multi-agent RL
items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful approach for improving reasoning in language and vision-language models, yet its strongest successes still depend heavily on ground-truth supervision (e.g., verifiable reward). items.note: 探索无监督推理涌现，对多智能体RL有参考价值。

items.title_en: OmniScientist: An Omni-Modal Omni-Discipline AI Scientist
items.summary: Recent advances in foundation models have enabled AI scientists to automate increasingly complete research workflows, from hypothesis generation and code execution to manuscript preparation. Yet workflow coverage alone does not provide access to the full evidence on which scientific discovery depends. items.title_cn: OmniScientist：全模态全学科AI科学家
items.note: 自动化科学研究工作流，对AI for Science有参考价值。

huggingface.models_summary: 这些热门模型（Qwen3.8系列、GLM-5.3等）都朝着多模态（图文结合）和高效化（Flash版、量化版）发展，说明AI正变得更易用、更快速。对于想跟进AI圈和备考的人，要注意多模态能力是趋势，同时学会使用量化模型在本地部署，能让你更灵活地应用AI。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在AI智能体（Agent）的构建与优化，包括训练数据生成、环境交互、装备（Harness）设计、多模态理解与生成，以及世界模型、强化学习等方向。近期热门是让AI在复杂真实场景中自主工作，如科学实验、城市导航、直播互动等。备考AI方向的新手应记住关键词：智能体（Agent）、多模态大模型（MLLM）、世界模型（World Model）、强化学习（RL）、数据生成（Data Generation）、装备（Harness）、具身智能（Embodied AI）、视频生成（Video Generation）、科学工作流（Scientific Workflow）等。
